name: What is the process for replacing kitchen countertops?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing kitchen countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, material preferences, and budget. Next, we take precise measurements of your existing countertops. Once you select a material, it is fabricated off-site. On installation day, we carefully remove your old countertops, install the new ones, and ensure a perfect fit. We manage all aspects, including coordinating with plumbers for sink and faucet reinstallation, to ensure a seamless project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, precise measurements, material fabrication, and professional installation. We manage all steps, including plumbing coordination, for a seamless replacement.
